text:
Police officer dies and another injured after backpack explosion in Oviedo
- Published
A police officer has died and another has been injured after a backpack exploded in the northern Spanish city of Oviedo.
The explosion happened when officers from Spain's canine unit and explosives disposal unit arrived and examined a suspicious backpack following reports of a dispute between neighbours on Tuesday morning.
A woman was shot during the dispute and the suspect is still at large, police said.
Both she and the injured officer have been taken to hospital for treatment.
Spanish police paid tribute to the dead officer, who has been named as Juan José, in a statement on X and said: "Our hearts are with his family, friends, colleagues and loved ones."
Officers attended the scene early on Tuesday morning following reports of an argument between neighbours and upon arriving found a woman who had sustained gunshot wounds, police spokesman Pedro Aguado said after the incident.
While searching for the suspected attacker, officers found a suspicious backpack and contacted both the bomb disposal unit and canine unit.
"While the package was being moved outside to ensure the safety of the residents, an explosion occurred," Aguado added.
The explosion left a member of the canine unit dead and an officer from the bomb disposal unit seriously injured, he said.
Responding to the incident, Spanish opposition leader and President of the People's Party Alberto Núñez Feijóo said: "What happened in Oviedo is heartbreaking.
"My condolences to the family of the officer who died and my best wishes for the recovery of the one who was seriously injured."
digest_he:
שוטר משטרת ספרד נהרג ושוטר נוסף נפצע קשה כתוצאה מפיצוץ של תיק גב חשוד בעיר אוביידו שבצפון המדינה. הפיצוץ אירע כאשר שוטרים מיחידות הכלבנים וחבלני המשטרה הגיעו לבדוק תיק חשוד במסגרת טיפול באירוע אלימות בין שכנים, שכלל ירי לעבר אישה.

האישה שנורתה והשוטר שנפצע באורח קשה פונו לקבלת טיפול רפואי בבית החולים, בעוד שהחשוד בירי טרם נתפס והחקירה נמשכת. ההנהגה בספרד ובכלל זה ראש האופוזיציה אלברטו נונייס פייחו הביעו זעזוע עמוק מהאירוע ושלחו תנחומים למשפחת השוטר ההרוג, שזהה כחואן חוסה.
